Class CPDFSignatureContainerRequest

  • Method Details

    • getDigestAlgorithm

      public String getDigestAlgorithm()
      Returns the digest algorithm used for the prepared PDF byte ranges.
      Returns:
      "SHA256"; the current entry point supports SHA-256 only

    • getDocumentDigest

      public byte[] getDocumentDigest()
      Returns the digest of the PDF's signed byte ranges, excluding the Contents placeholder.

      This is already a digest, not PDF content or a digest of CMS signed attributes. A CMS builder must use it as the messageDigest attribute, then sign the encoded signed attributes according to CMS rules. Hashing this value as document content would produce a container for a different message.

      Returns:
      a defensive copy of the 32-byte SHA-256 document digest; never null

    • getFieldName

      public String getFieldName()
      Returns the actual field name assigned during PDF preparation.
      Returns:
      the signature-field name, including a generated name when none was requested
